chunks: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'O Safwan! Buy a camel for me and take it deformed, for it is the thing with the longest lifespan.' So I bought a camel for him for eighty dirhams and went to him with it.
And in another narration, he said: 'Buy the black, ugly ones, for they are the thing with the longest lifespan.'

key_terms.أَشْوَه: Deformed/ugly-faced; in classical Arabic describes a creature with a misshapen or unattractive face
key_terms.أَعْمَار: Lifespans, plural of 'umr (life); the phrase 'أَطْوَلُ شَيْءٍ أَعْمَاراً' means 'the longest-lived thing'
key_terms.الْجَمَّال: The camel driver; Safwan's epithet indicating his profession
key_terms.الْقِبَاح: The ugly ones, plural of qabih; here referring to camels of unattractive appearance

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about buying camels? Which type of camel has the longest lifespan?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) instructed his companion Safwan al-Jammal, the well-known camel driver, to purchase a camel with physical deformities or dark coloring, stating that such animals have the longest lifespans. This practical guidance reflects traditional Arabian knowledge about animal husbandry that favored certain physical traits in camels for their durability. The hadith is preserved in two variant forms — one mentioning a deformed camel bought for eighty dirhams, and another recommending black, ugly camels — both conveying the same principle.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin MuhammadBin Khalid, from Al Hajjal, form Safwan Al Jammal who said, 
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Safwan! Buy a camel for me<sup>asws</sup> and take it as deformed, for it is something which is of longer life-span’. So I bought a camel for him<sup>asws</sup> with eighty Dirhams, and went over to him<sup>asws</sup> with it’.
And in another Hadeeth - ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Buy the black, the ugly, for it is something with a longer life-span’.
en.sarwar: 8. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from al-Hajj al from Safwan al-Jammal who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, once said, ‘Buy a camel for me, an ugly looking one, because it lives longer.’ I then bought for him (the Imam) a camel for eighty dirham and brought it to him (the Imam).”
In another Hadith it is said that he (the Imam) said, ‘Buy the black and ugly looking one because it lives longer.’
